end.summary:
Named polygons by counting straight sides: quadrilateral, pentagon, hexagon, and octagon.
Recognised polygons in different positions and sizes using side counting and the closed-shape idea.
Identified an equilateral triangle as one with three equal sides.
Triangle descriptions by angles were not yet demonstrated; teach-back was not passed.
end.parentNote: Asha practised naming polygons by counting their straight sides, including shapes with uneven sides, and recognising shapes in different positions and sizes. Veer explained that a closed shape with six straight sides is a hexagon and identified an equilateral triangle as having three equal sides. The angle words right, acute, and obtuse were not yet answered, so this was not corrected later in the lesson. At home, ask Veer to sort or draw triangles and label them by side length and by angle type.
